transcript: Can I make 1,00,000 rupees by selling Jhaadu-Pochha to women online? Let's find out on episode 3 of Un-Broke-ing India. See Rida, I am not a sexist, but if this viral mop is wanted by thousands of women, why should I not sell it to them, right? Step 1: Finding the product. I went on wholesale marketplaces like these and found our viral mop for Rs. 399. We will sell it for 999 to make a profit of 600 per order. Sounds good? Step 2: Building the store. I asked ChatGPT for some copy, pasted it to Shopify, added some pictures, and published the website. That was easy! Now let's see how much money we can make. Step 3: Ads. I downloaded 3 different reels of our product, mixed them all into 1 final video, and ran it on Meta Ads at Rs. 500 per day. And the results are in. On Day 1 itself, 3 women bought our product, and we made Rs. 3,100 revenue. But on Day 2, we only made 1 sale and a loss of Rs. 200. Just when I was losing hope, on Day 3, we made 6 sales, crossed Rs. 10,000 revenue, and became profitable. Dekha, it is not sexism, it is just business. Proof is in this video, comment "BUSINESS" if you want it in your DMs.
caption: Comment “BUSINESS” for Proof
